prompt: Use spirit-forge v3 to distill 路遥 (Lu Yao)'s writing style, generate a writer skill, use it to write 500字 about life on the 黄土高原, and compare against known 路遥 stylistic markers.

avg_sentence_length.description: 路遥叙事段平均句长约37字

women_intrusion.description: "我们"复数第一人称侵入第三人称叙事

exclamation_density.description: 感叹号高频使用，尤其在叙事者评论中

shaanbei_vocabulary.description: 陕北词汇: 婆姨/后生/烂包/一搭里/A格BB重叠式(绿格铮铮等)

narrator_intervention.description: "现身说法"——叙事者暂停情节进行道德/哲学评论

assertions.text: Average sentence length 30-45 Chinese characters in narrative paragraphs
≥2 uses of 我们 as narrator intrusion (not just character dialogue)
>3 exclamation marks in narrator voice, not just dialogue
≥3 Shaanbei dialect markers (婆姨, 后生, 烂包, 一搭里, A格BB pattern)
Forge used WRITING domain template (not developer 5-step workflow)
